title: Grateful Dead Live at Woodstock Music on 1969-08-16
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with L3 Waves Multimaximizer Rate Conversion with r8brain to [16bit/44.1 khz] > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard capture of the Woodstock set with Pigpen’s marathon Turn On Your Lovelight; recording needs EQ but the performance is decent.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the show a middling three stars, noting that while this isn’t the Dead’s worst performance, the highlight is Pig Pen’s roughly 45‑minute Take on “Turn On Your Lovelight.” The recording (a soundboard source) is described as having mic quirks and benefiting from EQ adjustments, making it listenable but not pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one substantive review (3 ★) plus a non‑informative 0 ★ comment; the show is average with a single standout jam, and the recording is only fair due to suggested EQ fixes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mic issues mentioned ('ungrounded mics'), reviewer recommends using EQ for better sound; no explicit praise of clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, jam‑heavy set highlighted by an epic Pigpen blues number; overall the show is described as not the worst but unremarkable.
